news.headline: Analysts Split on Abivax's Post-Earnings Reaction Ahead of Q2/H1 Report
news.summary: With Abivax's H1 2026 results due after the close on September 21, TipRanks noted the stock has fallen after six of its last eight earnings reports even as Wall Street's consensus stays Strong Buy with an average price target near $163. Analysts expect a $1.08 per-share loss on about $1.86 million of revenue.

news.headline: Top-Rated Analysts Revise Abivax Estimates as Earnings Call Approaches
news.summary: Benzinga highlighted recent forecast updates from high-accuracy analysts such as Piper Sandler's Allison Bratzel and Truist's Gregory Renza ahead of Abivax's September 21 earnings call. The piece framed the report as a key near-term test of sentiment following the company's positive pre-NDA FDA interaction.

news.headline: Abivax Shares Slide 5.6% as Investors De-Risk Before H1 Results
news.summary: ABVX dropped as low as $108.50 on light-volume selling that market watchers linked to pre-earnings positioning ahead of the September 21 half-year report. The move pared back some of the stock's early-September rally following the Goldman Sachs initiation.

news.headline: Bank of America Cuts Abivax Stake Below 5% Ownership Threshold
news.summary: Bank of America notified France's AMF that it had crossed below the 5% capital and voting-rights threshold in Abivax, now holding 4,323,717 shares (4.96% of capital), after selling shares on the open market. The filing follows BofA's crossing above the threshold earlier in the year.

news.headline: Wall Street Zen Lifts Abivax Rating to Hold From Sell
news.summary: Wall Street Zen upgraded Abivax from Sell to Hold, a more cautious counterpoint to the wave of bullish coverage the stock received earlier in the month. The move came just days after Goldman Sachs' Buy initiation pushed the stock toward multi-month highs.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax at Buy, Sees Obefazimod as Multi-Blockbuster
news.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Rajan Sharma started coverage of Abivax with a Buy rating and $155 price target, modeling roughly €4 billion in peak ulcerative colitis sales for obefazimod given its biologic-like efficacy. Shares rose about 3% to trade near €104 on Euronext Paris, extending an already unanimous Buy-side analyst panel.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to report first-half 2026 financial results after the U.S. market close on Monday, September 21, 2026 — as of this writing (September 19) the report has not yet occurred. Investors will watch for cash runway commentary, commercial build-out progress, and any update on NDA-readiness given the ~$920M July capital raise.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA (announced July 30, 2026), Abivax remains on track to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) submission
catalysts.detail: Abivax has guided to an EMA MAA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis following its U.S. NDA submission, but no specific submission date has been disclosed yet.

catalysts.label: UEG Week 2026
catalysts.detail: United European Gastroenterology Week 2026 takes place in Barcelona October 17-20; Abivax has presented obefazimod data at UEG in prior years, but the company has not yet issued a 2026 abstract-acceptance announcement.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease readout
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease is expected, though company disclosures have cited both "late 2026" and "mid-2027" at different points, so the exact timing is unsettled.

catalysts.label: Takeover / partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Persistent, unconfirmed reports (originating from a January 2026 La Lettre story) that Eli Lilly explored a roughly €15 billion acquisition of Abivax continue to circulate; management has said it is in no rush to do a deal and the $920M July raise was framed as supporting a potential solo U.S. launch instead.

pulse: Abivax remains one of biotech's highest-profile momentum stories: obefazimod's Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance and supplemental data, a positive July pre-NDA FDA meeting, and a fresh Goldman Sachs Buy initiation ($155 target, modeling ~€4B peak UC sales) pushed shares toward multi-month highs in early September. Sentiment has cooled slightly into mid-September — shares slipped roughly 5-6% and Bank of America trimmed its stake below the 5% disclosure threshold — as investors de-risk ahead of H1 2026 results due after the close on September 21, 2026 (not yet reported as of today). The core thesis is intact: an on-track late-Q4 2026 FDA NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, an EMA filing expected to follow, and lingering (unconfirmed) M&A speculation, with Wall Street overwhelmingly rated Buy/Strong Buy heading into the print.
